note: Opening a design now asks before discarding unsaved work - there is one autosave slot, so an Open used to lose it. The stability margin stops depending on how a part is clocked: the app measured the centre of pressure in one plane, so a rocket with fewer than three fins or a camera shroud reported a margin that changed when you rotated that part, and a shroud mounted straight up reported no CP shift at all. It now reports the most forward CP over a full roll sweep, which is what desktop OpenRocket shows; three or more fins are unaffected. Every tube in the catalogue is now selectable in the Scale dialog (1,094 were hidden behind "+N more"), each motor mount gets its own size choice, four double-listed manufacturers are merged, and a part pulled from the database shows its own material instead of "Custom".
